profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Currently working on Identity and Access Management (IAM) for IBM Cloud. Everything from authentication to authorization (RBAC and ABAC) and everything in between. Design, development and operations. 

A dependable and energetic software engineer focus on the application of technology to solve complex problems.
Strong commitment to best Software Development process and quality control standards.

Some of the tools I've used: Node.js, Python, Java, C, C#, SQL, Web Development, Linux, docker, OpenStack, Heat Templates, Cloud Foundry, kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cloud developer focus on Access management and Security for new IBM Bluemix platform.
Design and implement High Availability and high resiliency systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Now working on cloud based application working with AWS, tomcat, and play framework.
- Lead architect and developer for new application. Lead team that delivered the project from
inception to production.
- Refactor and improve execution time of existing application. Some processes improved from 5 hours
to under 5 minutes running time.
- Became subject matter expert on record time and presented project to team and clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Work on a large geographically diverse development team responsible for delivering fast and highly scalable enterprise I/O virtualization, cluster computing for Cloud computing enablement.
* Work with teams around different software development practices: from traditional waterfall, to TDD, agile development and everything in between.
* Design and implement improvements to solid DB schema, queries and stored procedures to extend system features and scalability.
* Lead developer for a multithreaded service at the heart of virtualization services in VIOS. Use technical expertise and service knowledge to guide other team members working on this service.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst III
positions.description:
* Assists in the management of electronic identities and access controls in the University’s information systems and services.
* Created the first workflow base application for automating and replacing current paper forms as part of the President’s initiative to automate the university.
* Provides the technical expertise and supervisory skills required to facilitate the transition of work from system analyst to programmers.
* Guided and tutored junior programmers in the development and modification of programs.
* Develops, tests, and maintains software (oracle, jsp, shell scripting). 
* Develops and maintains programming standards and documentation. 
* Meets with users to determine solutions, to assist and to train them, and to develop policies and procedures.

positions.title: Object Engineer
positions.description:
* Drove project teams that include members from other organizations to efficiently complete assignments on tight schedules.
* Provided technical software support and development for 200+ manufacturing machines and various Unix production servers to decrease down time and production line interruptions.
* Resolved daily production-stop issues to prevent economic loses and allow the company to meet customer expectations.
* Reviewed, updated, proposed and enforced software quality standards and best practices to application development processes in our organization.
* Designed and implemented a solution to incorporate new database information into current manufacturing flow of all the YE area in one of TI biggest factories.
* Enhanced several software applications by creating and documenting a simulator/test environment, significantly reducing the testing of future projects by ~40%.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
* Summer Internship
* Created a web-based reporting application to automate process and include additional features that notably increased productivity time.
* Worked as part of a team to developed and release several automation applications into production with zero quality issues.
* Effectively learned and executed new programming languages in record time to complete projects ahead of schedule.
* Demonstrated strong presentation skills by constantly delivering process reports to co-workers, customers and upper managers.
